subject: function:camera_mode_level
value: MEASURED VERDICT superseding the STRUCTURAL prose in attempt.camera-mode-level-bounded-hard-closure.20260829.v1 (2026-08-29): camera_mode_level is NOT structurally divergent. Counts are equal at 582/582 and the entire residual is THREE clusters: (A) a pure schedule displacement at +0x740 - ours emits `lwz r0,1624(r31)` before `addi r29,r31,1388`, retail emits the addi first; disjoint destinations (r0 vs r29), both merely read r31, and the addi is memory-free, so it is an ordinary order [1,0] permutation window; (B) the FORM PAIR at +0x8b0, which is the whole multiset delta (+1 mr / -1 li) - retail `mr r29,r30`, ours `li r27,0`; (C) a second displacement at +0x8c0 where our `addi r29,r4,200` leads retail's `li r4,0`. HANDOFF TO THE LZ LANE (work_claim.livezero-rule-class.20260901.v1): cluster B IS the live-zero form class, and specifically its HARD variant - li-vs-copy, not the unconditional mr-vs-addi variant - so it falls in the sub-population LZ's scope says to exclude from v1 unless the dominating-def audit is implemented. THIS PASS DISCHARGES THAT PROOF OBLIGATION BY MEASUREMENT, so the site is available as a ready-made test case if LZ does implement it. The obligation is that the copied source register provably holds the constant at the copy point. Here: +0x8b0 is the loop PREHEADER (the back-edge is `ble ->8b8` at +0x8fc, so the body starts at +0x8b8 and +0x8b0 executes once), retail seeds the 396-stride byte accumulator with `mr r29,r30` while we seed it with `li r27,0`, and r30 is provably 0 there - the sole dominating definition is `li r30,0` at +0x774 and the only other write to r30 is the loop's own `addi r30,r30,1` at +0x8d0, which the preheader precedes. Semantically identical, allocator-chosen, source-unreachable per the live-zero law. IMPORTANT SCOPE WARNING for whoever picks this up: closing camera_mode_level needs ALL THREE clusters plus a recolor (our r27/r4/r29 address web against retail's r29/r28), not just the form edit - the two displacements are already expressible with the EXISTING instruction_permutation stage, but the form pair is not expressible by any current stage, so this function cannot be closed until the new class ships. Until then it is correctly a park, but a park with a fully named mechanism rather than a STRUCTURAL label.
